text:
Predicates:
City(x) ::: x is a city.
In(x, y) ::: x is in state y.
Includes(x, y) ::: x includes the city y.
SameState(x, y) ::: x and y are cities in the same state.
Premises:
City(billings) ∧ In(billings, montana) ::: Billings is a city in Montana.
Includes(montana, butte) ∧ Includes(montana, helena) ∧ Includes(montana, missoula) ::: Montana includes the cities of Butte, Helena, and Missoula.
City(whiteSulphurSprings) ∧ City(butte) ∧ SameState(whiteSulphurSprings, butte) ::: White Sulphur Springs and Butte are cities in the same state.
City(pierre) ∧ ¬In(pierre, montana) ::: The city of Pierre is not in Montana.
∀x (In(x, butte) → ¬In(x, pierre)) ::: Any city in Butte is not in Pierre.
Conclusion:
In(missoula, montana) ::: Montana is home to the city of Missoula.
